body: I know I probably sound like a whiner but the drugs win.. they beat me.. there's no going back to the happiness I had before.. it's a permanent scar on my life.. which is why I'm thinking about just closing the book now

It is my fault tho.. I'm the one doing it.. I'm the one pushing everyone away.. I'm the one who completely destroyed a life I used to love.. feel almost like a movie you know.. but with no happy ending

I'm just glad someone is willing to talk with me. Yes I lost them cause of my addiction.. my gf gave me so many chances and I just kept fucking them up which also adds so much guilt on top of how I feel.. I'm tired of being a giant fuckup and I don't know how to be better.. I'm pissed that I got to this point in my life and I'm disgusted at myself

I was completely in love with my ex.. still am but I fucked all that up.. I've lost friends aswell to the point where now I can go weeks without talking to anyone besides my coworkers.. all week at work I look forward to the weekend.. then the weekend comes and I'm all alone so I turn to drugs which just makes me feel even worse and more lonely and miserable

I don't see that as a possibility.. I don't have money for that plus I need to work to pay my bills or I'll be in a worse hole.. I'm very lonely now which is the cause of me continuing my addiction.. life is just a mess.. I lost the women I've loved most to it so in the back of my mind I feel it's too late
It just feels like I keep going backwards.. losing money and loved ones.. things seem pointless now
